summary.en: Gunmen attacked a shopping complex in Osun, killing three and injuring four, while separate gun attacks killed three and wounded four in Sokoto targeting an ADC governorship candidate and prompted condemnation by Tambuwal. ISWAP fighters were killed in clashes with Nigerian troops in Borno and Yobe, with 48 militants killed and one soldier dead, and a separate attack on the Binnari community resulted in at least 58 deaths. Three abducted Islamic clerics in Zamfara were rescued after weeks of captivity. The conflict produced 1,486 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Våpenbærende menn angrep et kjøpesenter i Osun, drepte tre og såret fire, mens separate skyteangrep drepte tre og såret fire i Sokoto, rettet mot en ADC-gubernatorskandidat og førte til fordømmelse fra Tambuwal. ISWAP-krigere ble drept i kamper med nigeriske tropper i Borno og Yobe, med 48 militante drept og én soldat død, og et separat angrep på Binnari-samfunnet resulterte i minst 58 døde. Tre bortførte islamske lærde i Zamfara ble reddet etter flere ukers fangenskap. Konflikten førte til 1 486 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Boko Haram insurgency
background.extract: The Boko Haram insurgency began in July 2009, when the militant Islamist and jihadist rebel group Boko Haram started an armed rebellion against the government of Nigeria. Boko Haram targets both Muslims and Christians. Attacks are often directed at individuals perceived as supporting the Nigerian government or Islamic State after the split between them, including civil servants, local defense groups, Muslim leaders who oppose the group and other rebels like al-Qaeda and Islamic State. Most attacks are not based on the religion of the victims.
